title.zh: AI 交出 700 多份手稿，数学家为何分歧如此之大？
title.en: AI released 700-plus manuscripts. Why are mathematicians divided?

description.zh: 10 月 6 日，OpenAI 公布内部模型生成的数学研究材料。有人把它看作科研加速的起点，有人呼吁停止合作。这两种反应，究竟在回答什么问题？
description.en: On October 6, OpenAI released mathematical research generated by an internal model. Some saw an acceleration of discovery; others called for a boycott. What lies behind these different responses?

title.zh: 聊了两小时的 Agent，为什么会忘记最初的要求？
title.en: Why can an agent forget a request from two hours ago?

description.zh: Pi 的两篇工程文章，拆开了长期对话中的两个问题：有限的工作记忆，以及反复读取历史的成本。
description.en: Two Pi engineering articles examine limited working context and the cost of repeatedly processing conversation history.

title.zh: Agent 做到一半断了，重启后能接着干吗？
title.en: Can an agent resume after crashing halfway through a task?

description.zh: Pi Durable 为长时间运行的 Agent 保存工作状态。难点出现在它已经影响了外部世界，却还没来得及留下完整记录的时候。
description.en: Pi Durable persists work for long-running agents. The difficult case arises when an external action has happened but its result has not yet been recorded.

title.zh: Dream-RSI：让 AI 从走过的弯路里，学会安排下一次实验
title.en: Dream-RSI: using past experiments to plan the next attempt

description.zh: 研究团队把代码优化的历史变成可重放的环境，再让 AI 改写探索策略。“做梦”省掉了什么，又没有省掉什么？
description.en: The researchers turn code-optimization history into a replay environment, then use AI to revise the search policy. What does this “dreaming” save?

title.zh: PANDA：一群 Agent，怎样组队才有意义？
title.en: PANDA: how should a group of agents form a useful team?

description.zh: 这篇论文把目光放在协作基础设施：找到合适的伙伴，按任务组织通信，并在成员失联时继续工作。
description.en: This paper studies collaboration infrastructure: finding suitable partners, organizing communication around a task and continuing when a participant fails.

title.zh: REA
title.en: REA

description.zh: 让编码 Agent 通过 MCP 检查应用行为与二进制，沿着证据理解一个功能怎样实现。
description.en: Connect a coding agent to application and binary inspection through MCP, tracing how a feature works.

title.zh: Designeer
title.en: Designeer

description.zh: 把设计工具、组件、学习资料与设计工程师放在一个可浏览的资源目录里。
description.en: A browsable directory of design tools, components, learning resources and design engineers.

title.zh: GitAgent
title.en: GitAgent

description.zh: 把 Agent 的身份、规则、记忆与技能写进 Git 仓库，用版本管理保留修改过程。
description.en: Keep an agent’s identity, rules, memory and skills in a Git repository, with versioned changes.

title.zh: Monid
title.en: Monid

description.zh: 让 Agent 从统一入口发现并调用工具，提供 Skill、MCP 与 CLI 接入方式。
description.en: A shared entry point for agents to discover and call tools through skills, MCP or a CLI.

title.zh: OpenBot
title.en: OpenBot

description.zh: 在桌面端给不同 Agent 配置指令和工作区，让它们交接任务、共享文件。
description.en: Give desktop agents separate instructions and workspaces, with task handoff and shared files.

title.zh: Rill
title.en: Rill

description.zh: 把浏览页面与 Claude Code、Codex 任务放在同一个窗口，减少页面和项目之间的切换。
description.en: Bring browsing and Claude Code or Codex tasks into one window, connecting pages with project work.

title.zh: Mintlify
title.en: Mintlify

description.zh: 让人和 Agent 都更方便地阅读、搜索与使用产品文档，连接文档和 API 工作流。
description.en: Help people and agents read, search and use product documentation alongside API workflows.

title.zh: Lapis One
title.en: Lapis One

description.zh: 给 Agent 一台独立的 Debian 电脑，并提供远程连接和控制其他设备的硬件入口。
description.en: A dedicated Debian computer for agents, with remote access and hardware connections to other devices.

title.zh: vPhone Workstation
title.en: vPhone Workstation

description.zh: 在原生 macOS 窗口中管理虚拟 iPhone，查看设备库、配置和启动状态。
description.en: Manage virtual iPhones in a native macOS window, with a device library, settings and lifecycle controls.

title.zh: T3 Code
title.en: T3 Code

description.zh: 把多个编程 Agent 的对话、代码差异与 Git 协作放进一个开源图形控制台。
description.en: An open-source graphical workspace for coding-agent threads, diffs and Git collaboration.

title.zh: 把反复犯的错，写成下一次会失败的检查
title.en: Turn recurring mistakes into failing checks

description.zh: /correct 讨论的是编程 Agent 反复犯同一种错时，怎样把纠正留下来：把约束写进 lint、类型检查或测试。下一次即使模型忘了口头提醒，执行检查仍会给出具体反馈。它把“记住教训”变成了工作环境的一部分，适合那些能清楚描述失败条件的错误。
description.en: The /correct proposal turns recurring coding mistakes into lint rules, type checks or tests. Even when an agent forgets a verbal correction, the environment can report the same concrete failure. This preserves feedback where the failure condition can be stated clearly.

title.zh: 文件名会变，项目约束仍要说清楚
title.en: Names change; project constraints still need clarity

description.zh: 这篇收藏讨论 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 与 Agent 运行环境的定制。这类文件承担的是项目交接：告诉 Agent 怎样构建、怎样验收、哪些约束不能漏。真正有价值的内容是能让它开始工作的具体信息；文件名与加载方式则需要随所用工具一起确认。
description.en: This reading discusses CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and customization of the environment around an agent. These files serve as project handoffs: how to build, how to validate and which constraints matter. Useful instructions make work startable; filenames and loading behavior remain tool-specific.

title.zh: EmbeddingGemma 2：让不同模态进入同一检索空间
title.en: EmbeddingGemma 2: one retrieval space across modalities

description.zh: Google 的模型卡确认文本、图像、视频与音频可以映射到同一 768 维空间，并允许按需加载编码器。它值得从一个自己的资料库任务试起：用文字找到相关图片或录音。先评估召回结果与设备负担，再判断是否适合长期使用。
description.en: Google’s model card describes text, image, video and audio embeddings in a shared 768-dimensional space, with selectively loaded encoders. Try a personal-library task, such as finding an image or recording from text, then evaluate retrieval and device overhead.

title.zh: Jev 的应用目录又长了一点
title.en: The Jev application list keeps growing

description.zh: 本条收藏记录 awesome-jev 从 583 到 591 条的巡检，新增方向涉及 bisect、审核与安全扫描。这里更值得逐项看的是：决策层在哪里接入、判断之后由谁执行。目录规模是原帖的时点记录，不代表每个项目都已经成熟。
description.en: The saved inspection note records awesome-jev growing from 583 to 591 entries, including bisect, moderation and security work. Examine where each decision layer connects and what executes afterward. The count is a snapshot, not a maturity rating.

title.zh: DEX #366：个人 Agent 需要怎样的电脑
title.en: DEX #366: what computer does a personal agent need?

description.zh: DEX 把个人 Agent、云端电脑和 AI 电脑放在一起，很适合比较任务住在哪里：随身设备、常驻主机，还是临时云桌面。选择环境时，先想任务是否要持续运行、要访问什么资料、故障后怎样接手；再看硬件和服务。
description.en: DEX groups personal agents, cloud desktops and AI computers. Compare where a task lives: a portable device, an always-on host or a temporary cloud desktop. Start with persistence, data access and recovery needs before choosing hardware or services.

title.zh: 16 款产品，反复出现的是记忆与主动性
title.en: Across 16 products, memory and initiative recur

description.zh: Founder Park 的产品合集覆盖 Personal Agent、垂直助手和记忆工具。适合当一张候选清单来浏览，先选与你眼下任务相邻的一款。主动提醒能否帮忙，要看它记住了什么、何时打断你，以及能否让你检查和修正。
description.en: Founder Park’s roundup spans personal agents, specialist assistants and memory tools. Use it as a candidate list and try one adjacent to a current task. Useful initiative depends on what a tool remembers, when it interrupts and whether you can inspect and correct it.

title.zh: Thin Is In：界面变薄以后，控制留在哪里
title.en: Thin Is In: where does control live in a thinner interface?

description.zh: 《Thin Is In》把持续存在的 Agent 与更轻的交互界面联系起来。过去需要打开应用、点击多个入口的工作，可能收敛为一句委托。由此产生的新设计题是：操作入口少了，任务进度、所用材料和用户接管的位置，应该怎样保留下来？
description.en: Thin Is In connects persistent agents with lighter interfaces. Work that once required opening an app and navigating several controls may begin with a short request. That creates a design question: where do progress, source material and opportunities to take over remain visible?

title.zh: AIGC Weekly #191：本期只读到公开节选
title.en: AIGC Weekly #191: a partial reading

description.zh: 已缓存的公开部分涉及 Personal Agent、AI 反编译与跨设备工作。阅读流标注目前只收到了约 21% 内容，因此这里只保留这份节选的线索，不把它写成完整一期的结论；想读全篇，可以回到原订阅渠道。
description.en: The cached portion covers personal agents, AI decompilation and cross-device work. The stream reports roughly 21% coverage, so this note retains the excerpt’s threads without presenting a verdict on the entire newsletter. The full issue belongs in its subscription channel.

title.zh: AI 越来越常用，是否就说明投入越来越值得？
title.en: Does more AI usage mean better value?

description.zh: 卡兹克对照 A16Z 的两份报告，观察 AI 的使用频率、付费与消费集中。它提供了从“模型又强了多少”转向“人们怎样使用 AI”的视角。读这类数据时，我会把使用者、付费者与整体人群分开：付费增长说明需求，却还需要任务完成、节省时间和持续使用的数据，才能解释用户获得了什么价值。
description.en: Kazike compares two A16Z reports on usage frequency, payment and concentration of spending. The useful shift is from model capability to how people use AI. Users, paying users and the general population are different denominators. Spending indicates demand; completed tasks, time saved and continued use help explain the value delivered.

title.zh: 手指的间隙：一个看得见的芝诺悖论
title.en: The gap between fingers: seeing Zeno’s paradox

description.zh: 原帖把指缝不断对半的过程拍给孩子看。它提醒我，解释一个概念不一定先搬出复杂符号。下面是编者自己的等比图解：无穷多个剩余步骤，也可能有有限的总和；‘步骤无穷’本身，并不能推出‘时间无穷’。
description.en: The original post shows a child a finger gap repeatedly halving. Explanation need not begin with complicated notation. Our geometric-series sketch below makes one point: infinitely many remaining steps can have a finite sum; infinitely many steps alone do not imply infinite time.

title.zh: 《动手学大语言模型》：把图解当成学习路径
title.en: Hands-On Large Language Models: learn through diagrams

description.zh: Jay Alammar 与 Maarten Grootendorst 的《动手学大语言模型》，用图解和代码连接模型原理与实际应用。它适合补齐本期工程专题背后的基础：文本怎样变成 token，向量怎样支持检索，一次生成怎样接着已有输入继续。把机制看明白，再回头读产品宣称，更容易判断变化发生在哪一层。
description.en: Jay Alammar and Maarten Grootendorst’s Hands-On Large Language Models connects model concepts to applications through illustrations and code. It provides useful background for this issue: tokens, vector retrieval and generation conditioned on earlier input. Understanding the mechanism makes it easier to locate what a product claim actually changes.
